claim_ceiling: One passenger-car tire-health dataset is vendored under its upstream CC BY 4.0 license and its ordered shard concatenation was checked against the upstream GitHub blob content. Other records remain rights requests, external references or proxy-only sources. No motorcycle component maps are yet acquired; no tire performance is physically validated.

sources.title: Multi-scenario tire monitoring dataset with synchronized pressure, temperature, and speed measurements

sources.evidence_class: mixed: InstrumentedPhysical (controlled deflation) and FieldObserved (normal driving / natural leakage)

not tire-force, grip, puncture-resistance, compound, tread-wear or structural qualification data

dataset combines controlled experimental deflation segments with natural leak and normal-driving segments; retain Collection_Method in all analysis
